note: Family campground (est. 1973) NE of Columbus; mostly wooded lots with a small creek alongside, walking trails. --Claude
summary: Rate $50 -> $55 posted; May 1-Oct 31 confirmed; RV only (no tent sites); no sewer; 130 sites and 28 ft cleared; .site domain live; passes only on the Columbus gateway.
flags: GATE: posted $55 a night with no year on the page ('Daily $55'), stored $50. Over $50, but Columbus metro is 27 km away (gateways.py), so the gateway exception holds. Not a family stay (0 references). Not checked as a Good Sam Park beyond gsr.py returning no match for this name. Google 4.4 over 188 reviews, open, 740-965-3469. RV Life campers paid $50 in 5/2026 and 5/2025, $45 in 7/2024, $40 in 10/2025 (a stay of a couple of weeks).

REVIEWS, good: 5/2026 'Pleasant campground, staff very nice'; 5/2025 motorhome 'It is a little tight for large rigs (we are 43 feet), but manageable', docked a star for no sewer; 7/2024 'Sites are close together and small ... lots of seasonal campers ... clean and well maintained ... Very quiet at night'.

LONG-STAY (test 4): seasonal in character. Rules speak of 'Seasonals are responsible for the upkeep of their lots', 'Only 1 shed per lot', and 'We are unable to accept units built before 2005 for monthly or seasonal stays' (does not bind nightly). Imagery shows most lots in the woods looking settled. Share not posted; with no tent sites there's nothing else to count. Test 2 passes: $55 nightly posted and the rate page says it offers 'overnight visits as well as extended stays'.

CHECK: 'Max RV ~28 ft' had no operator source (only directories) and a camper fit a 43-ft rig, so it was cleared; EKKO's 23 ft isn't in question. The 'pull_through' stays as stored: RV Life campers report pull-throughs (site 54, 5/2025) though the operator's pages don't say. Tent claim in inclusion_evidence ('50 tent') is contradicted by 'We do not have sites for tent camping'.

WEBSITE: http://www.treehavencampground.site/ is live (a 301 to /index.html). Do NOT use www.treehavencampground.com, which the amenities page still prints: it redirects to gambling sites (raja700z.com -> primbon-togel.com). The visitdelohio second line is a tourism listing and can go. Stored pin is at the entrance beside the sites (fine); the operator's posted GPS (40 9'30.78"N, 82 49'34.31"W) plots ~370 m west, in a field.
Stored not waterfront stands: operator says only 'A small creek runs alongside the campground'; which pads touch it wasn't plotted, canopy hides them.
